learning_outcomes.text: Possess and understand knowledge that provides a basis or opportunity to be original in the development and/or application of ideas, often in a research context.
Students know how to apply the acquired knowledge and their problem-solving ability in new or little-known environments within broader (or multidisciplinary) contexts related to their field of study.

Students are able to integrate knowledge and face the complexity of formulating judgments based on information that, being incomplete or limited, includes reflections on the social and ethical responsibilities linked to the application of their knowledge and judgments.
Students know how to communicate their conclusions and the knowledge and ultimate reasons that support them to specialized and non-specialized audiences clearly and unambiguously.
Students possess the learning skills that allow them to continue studying in a largely self-directed or autonomous way.
Develop the potential of information and communication technologies in industrial production.
Apply the knowledge obtained in the master's degree to achieve greater efficiency, effectiveness, reliability or safety in an industrial environment.

Apply the most advanced technologies in intelligent computer control, automation and plant-level communication systems for flexible manufacturing and industrial inspection systems in complex installations.
Manage, both theoretically and practically, the specific equipment for monitoring and controlling automatic production systems.

Specify, design, develop, install, commission and maintain the hardware and software computer architecture of an industrial plant, including automation systems based on programmable controllers and industrial inspection systems for quality control, predictive maintenance and improved process knowledge.
Correctly apply the specifications, regulations and mandatory standards in the field of automatic industrial production systems.
Use the acquired knowledge to maintain a critical and active attitude in the management of automation projects.

Apply the competencies acquired in the master's degree in a real work environment, integrated into a work team within a company that carries out its activity in one of the fields related to the master's degree.

Apply the acquired theoretical knowledge, putting it into practice in the development of external work linked to the exercise of activity in an appropriate professional, public or private environment.
Ability to work in multidisciplinary teams.

syllabus_topics: Integration of the student into operational work teams
Familiarization with a non-academic external work environment
teaching_methods: Work in a company or entity

assessment_methods.method: Evaluation according to the University of Oviedo's internship evaluation regulations

assessment_rules: The evaluation of Company Internships is carried out according to the University of Oviedo's internship evaluation regulations. The specific procedures are detailed at http://maiind.dieecs.com/practicas-externas. The "Acuerdo de 14 de octubre de 2014, del Consejo de Gobierno de la Universidad de Oviedo, por el que se aprueba el Reglamento de Prácticas Externas de la Universidad de Oviedo" also applies.
